notes.title: Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43765668/12e32804cc3e99a9247f2fa6b31f45ccc48f308f.png

Hello everyone, Thank you for playing the game. I'm working on general bug fixes and battle balance adjustments. Please let me know here if you encounter any bugs :)

[10-24-2023 update]

MacOs supports.
Green pipe Level UI graphic is now more clear and easy to understand.
Added 'Dumbbell holic' talent in Triple Protein combo and so on.
Upgraded all throwing weapons more usable than before.
Fixed overall English font more visible.
